sql.processStepEvent.getStepEvents: select pse.id, pse.process_step_id, pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id, cest.event_status_type as initial_event_status_type, pse.event_id, pse.archived, e.event_name, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psea))) FROM ( SELECT psea.id, psea.action_name as "actionName", psea.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", psea.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", psea.company_event_status_type_id as "companyEventStatusTypeId", psea.created_by_id as "createdById", psea.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cest.event_status_type as "eventStatusType", psea.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psearf))) FROM ( select psearf.id, psearf.process_step_event_action_id as "processStepEventActionId", psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id as "customFieldGroupAssignmentId", psearf.archived, cf.field_name as "fieldName", cfg.group_name as "groupName" from flow.process_step_event_action_required_field psearf inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id where psearf.archived is false and psearf.process_step_event_action_id = psea.id) psearf), '[]') AS "requiredFields" FROM flow.process_step_event_action psea left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psea.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on psea.company_event_status_type_id = cest.id WHERE psea.process_step_event_id = pse.id AND psea.archived is not true) psea), '[]') AS "processStepEventActions" from flow.process_step_event pse inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on cest.id = pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id where pse.process_step_id = :processStepId and e.resource_custom_field_id is not null and pse.archived is not true
sql.processStepEvent.getAvailableEventsForSt: select e.id, e.event_name, e.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(statuses))) FROM ( select cest.id, cest.event_status_type as "eventStatusType", ecest.archived, est.event_status_type as "rootEventStatusType", cest.event_status_type_id as "eventStatusTypeId" from flow.event_company_event_status_type ecest inner join flow.company_event_status_type cest on ecest.company_event_status_type_id = cest.id inner join flow.event_status_type est on cest.event_status_type_id = est.id where ecest.event_id = e.id and ecest.archived is not true ) statuses), '[]') AS "companyEventStatusTypes" from flow.event e where e.archived is not true and not exists ( select pse.event_id from flow.process_step_event pse where pse.process_step_id = :processStepId and pse.event_id = e.id and pse.archived is not true )
sql.processStepEvent.get: select pse.id, pse.process_step_id, pse.event_id, pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id, cest.event_status_type as initialEventStatusType, e.event_name, pse.archived, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(psea))) FROM ( SELECT psea.id, psea.action_name as "actionName", psea.process_step_event_id as "processStepEventId", psea.company_process_step_status_type_id as "companyProcessStepStatusTypeId", psea.company_event_status_type_id as "companyEventStatusTypeId", psea.created_by_id as "createdById", psea.modified_by_id as "modifiedById", cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cest.event_status_type as "eventStatusType", psea.archived FROM flow.process_step_event_action psea left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psea.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on psea.company_event_status_type_id = cest.id WHERE psea.process_step_event_id = pse.id AND psea.archived is not true) psea), '[]') AS "processStepEventActions" from flow.process_step_event pse inner join flow.event e on pse.event_id = e.id inner join flow.company_event_status_type cest on pse.initial_company_event_status_type_id = cest.id where pse.id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.addEventToStep: insert into flow.process_step_event(process_step_id, event_id, created_by_id, initial_company_event_status_type_id) values (:processStepId, :eventId, :createdById, :initialCompanyEventStatusTypeId)
sql.processStepEvent.updateStepEvent: update flow.process_step_event set initial_company_event_status_type_id = :initialCompanyEventStatusTypeId, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where process_step_id = :processStepId and event_id = :eventId
sql.processStepEvent.deleteEventFromStep: update flow.process_step_event set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.addStepEventAction: insert into flow.process_step_event_action(process_step_event_id, company_event_status_type_id, company_process_step_status_type_id, action_name, created_by_id) values(:processStepEventId, :companyEventStatusTypeId, :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, :actionName, :userId)
sql.processStepEvent.updateStepEventAction: update flow.process_step_event_action set company_event_status_type_id = :companyEventStatusTypeId, action_name = :actionName, company_process_step_status_type_id = :companyProcessStepStatusTypeId, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.getStepEventAction: select psea.*, cpsst.process_step_status_type as "processStepStatusType", cest.event_status_type as "eventStatusType" from flow.process_step_event_action psea left join flow.company_process_step_status_type cpsst on psea.company_process_step_status_type_id = cpsst.id left join flow.company_event_status_type cest on psea.company_event_status_type_id = cest.id where psea.id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.deleteActionFromEvent: update flow.process_step_event_action set archived = true, date_modified = now(), modified_by_id = :userId where id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.deleteRequiredField: update flow.process_step_event_action_required_field set archived = true, modified_by_id = :userId, date_modified = now() where id = :requiredFieldId
sql.processStepEvent.getActionRequiredField: select psearf.*, cf.field_name, cfg.group_name from flow.process_step_event_action_required_field psearf inner join flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga on psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cfga.custom_field_id = cf.id inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfga.custom_field_group_id = cfg.id where psearf.archived is false and psearf.id = :id
sql.processStepEvent.getAvailableCustomField: select cf.id, cf.field_name, cfg.company_object_type_id, cfga.id as custom_field_group_assignment_id from flow.custom_field_group_assignment cfga inner join flow.custom_field_group cfg on cfg.id = cfga.custom_field_group_id inner join flow.custom_field cf on cf.id = cfga.custom_field_id inner join flow.company_object_type cot on cot.id = cfg.company_object_type_id where cot.object_type_id = 6 and cfga.archived is not true and cf.archived is not true and cfg.archived is not true and cfg.event_id = :eventId and not exists ( select psearf.id from flow.process_step_event_action_required_field psearf where psearf.custom_field_group_assignment_id = cfga.id and psearf.process_step_event_action_id = :actionId and psearf.archived is false ) order by field_name
